summary: On the main deck, Tank punches the exit command, then says "Got him." In response, Cypher's body, held in its harness, twitches and jerks itself awake.

what_changes.before: Unconscious or disconnected, inert in its harness.
what_changes.after: Being jerked awake as the exit command takes effect.
what_changes.evidence: Cypher's body twitches in its harness, jerking itself awake.

event_hint.one_line: Tank jacks Cypher out of the Matrix, his body waking in the harness.
